body:
For f(x)=x²−3x, the average rate of change from x=1 to x=4 is

Choices:
A. 0
B. 2
C. 3
D. 5

Which end behavior matches P(x)=−2x⁵+7x²−1?

Choices:
A. P→∞ at both ends
B. P→−∞ at both ends
C. P→∞ as x→−∞ and P→−∞ as x→∞
D. P→−∞ as x→−∞ and P→∞ as x→∞

The graph of R(x)=(x²−5x+6)/(x−2) has

Choices:
A. a vertical asymptote at x=2
B. a hole at (2,−1)
C. a hole at (2,1)
D. no discontinuity

A polynomial has zeros −1 of multiplicity 2 and 3 of multiplicity 1. Which behavior is required?

Choices:
A. It crosses at both zeros
B. It touches at −1 and crosses at 3
C. It crosses at −1 and touches at 3
D. It touches at both zeros

A cubic model fits sales data for 0≤t≤12 months. Which use requires the greatest caution?

Choices:
A. Interpolating at t=6
B. Computing the model at t=0
C. Predicting at t=60
D. Comparing t=4 and t=5

If f(x)=2x−1 and g(x)=x²+3, then (g∘f)(x)=

Choices:
A. 2x²+2
B. (2x−1)²+3
C. 2x²+5
D. x²+2x+2

For Q(x)=(x−1)²(x+2)/(x²+1), the right-end behavior is closest to

Choices:
A. Q(x) behaves like 0
B. Q(x) behaves like 1
C. Q(x) behaves like x
D. Q(x) behaves like x²

A quantity starts at 80 and grows by 6% each period. A suitable model is

Choices:
A. 80+0.06t
B. 80(0.06)^t
C. 80(1.06)^t
D. 1.06(80)^t

Solve log₂(x−1)=3.

Choices:
A. x=4
B. x=7
C. x=8
D. x=9

The inverse of f(x)=3e^(2x) is

Choices:
A. (1/2)ln(x/3)
B. 2ln(3x)
C. ln(x−3)/2
D. 3ln(x/2)

If 5^(2x−1)=17, then x equals

Choices:
A. (1+log₅17)/2
B. (log₅17−1)/2
C. 1+2log₅17
D. log₅(17/2)

A residual plot for an exponential regression shows a clear U-shaped pattern. This most strongly indicates

Choices:
A. the data are exactly exponential
B. the model systematically misses curvature
C. all residuals are zero
D. the response variable is categorical

A medicine has half-life 5 hours. The fraction remaining after 15 hours is

Choices:
A. 1/2
B. 1/4
C. 1/8
D. 1/16

For h(x)=ln(x²−4), the domain is

Choices:
A. x>2 only
B. x<−2 only
C. −2<x<2
D. x<−2 or x>2

Convert 150° to radians.

Choices:
A. 5π/12
B. 5π/6
C. 5π/3
D. 6π/5

A sinusoid has maximum 14, minimum 6, and period 8. Its amplitude and midline are

Choices:
A. 4 and y=10
B. 8 and y=10
C. 4 and y=8
D. 10 and y=4

On 0≤x<2π, the solutions to 2sin x=√3 are

Choices:
A. π/3 only
B. 2π/3 only
C. π/3 and 2π/3
D. 4π/3 and 5π/3

If θ=arccos(−1/2), using the principal range of arccos, then θ=

Choices:
A. π/3
B. 2π/3
C. 4π/3
D. 5π/3

The polar point (r,θ)=(−3,π/6) has Cartesian coordinates

Choices:
A. (3√3/2,3/2)
B. (−3√3/2,−3/2)
C. (−3√3/2,3/2)
D. (−3/2,−3√3/2)

For the polar curve r=4sin θ, which description is correct?

Choices:
A. A circle of radius 2 centered at (0,2)
B. A circle of radius 4 centered at the origin
C. A circle of radius 2 centered at (2,0)
D. A line y=4

No calculator is permitted.

Which statement describes the end behavior of q(x)=−3x⁵+2x²−7?

A. q(x)→∞ at both ends
B. q(x)→−∞ at both ends
C. q(x)→−∞ as x→∞ and q(x)→∞ as x→−∞
D. q(x)→∞ as x→∞ and q(x)→−∞ as x→−∞

Choices:
A. q(x)→∞ at both ends
B. q(x)→−∞ at both ends
C. q(x)→−∞ as x→∞ and q(x)→∞ as x→−∞
D. q(x)→∞ as x→∞ and q(x)→−∞ as x→−∞

No calculator is permitted.

For r(x)=(x+1)/(x²−5x+6), which values are vertical asymptotes?

A. x=−1 only
B. x=2 only
C. x=3 only
D. x=2 and x=3

Choices:
A. x=−1 only
B. x=2 only
C. x=3 only
D. x=2 and x=3

No calculator is permitted.

Let h(x)=(x²−9)/(x−3) for x≠3. Which statement is true?

A. The graph has a hole at (3,6).
B. The graph has a vertical asymptote at x=3.
C. The graph has a hole at (−3,0).
D. The graph is the entire line y=x+3.

Choices:
A. The graph has a hole at (3,6).
B. The graph has a vertical asymptote at x=3.
C. The graph has a hole at (−3,0).
D. The graph is the entire line y=x+3.

No calculator is permitted.

If g(x)=−2f(x−3)+5, which transformation takes the graph of f to the graph of g?

A. Left 3, vertical stretch 2, reflect across x-axis, up 5
B. Right 3, vertical stretch 2, reflect across x-axis, up 5
C. Right 5, vertical shrink 1/2, down 3
D. Left 5, vertical stretch 2, reflect across y-axis, up 3

Choices:
A. Left 3, vertical stretch 2, reflect across x-axis, up 5
B. Right 3, vertical stretch 2, reflect across x-axis, up 5
C. Right 5, vertical shrink 1/2, down 3
D. Left 5, vertical stretch 2, reflect across y-axis, up 3

No calculator is permitted.

A table has constant second differences and nonconstant first differences for equally spaced inputs. Which model type is most appropriate?

A. Linear
B. Exponential
C. Quadratic
D. Sinusoidal

Choices:
A. Linear
B. Exponential
C. Quadratic
D. Sinusoidal

No calculator is permitted.

When p(x)=2x³−3x²+4x−5 is divided by x−2, what is the remainder?

A. 3
B. 12
C. 15
D. 7

Choices:
A. 3
B. 12
C. 15
D. 7

Calculator use is permitted.

A cubic regression for data is y=0.42x³−1.8x²+0.65x+7.1. What is the predicted change in y from x=2.4 to x=3.1, to the nearest hundredth?

A. 0.64
B. 0.23
C. 1.29
D. 3.43

Choices:
A. 0.64
B. 0.23
C. 1.29
D. 3.43

Calculator use is permitted.

For f(x)=x⁴−6x²+2, what is the average rate of change from x=1.2 to x=2.7, to the nearest tenth?

A. -10.6
B. 24.0
C. 10.6
D. 16.0

Choices:
A. -10.6
B. 24.0
C. 10.6
D. 16.0

No calculator is permitted.

For f(x)=7(1.12)^x, which statement is true?

A. f decreases by 12% per unit
B. f increases by 112% per unit
C. f has a constant increase of 0.12
D. f increases by 12% per unit

Choices:
A. f decreases by 12% per unit
B. f increases by 112% per unit
C. f has a constant increase of 0.12
D. f increases by 12% per unit

No calculator is permitted.

Which expression is equivalent to 5·2^(3x−1)?

A. (5/2)·8^x
B. 10·8^x
C. 5·6^x−1
D. (5/2)·6^x

Choices:
A. (5/2)·8^x
B. 10·8^x
C. 5·6^x−1
D. (5/2)·6^x

No calculator is permitted.

What is the solution to log₃(x−1)+log₃(x+1)=2?

A. x=3
B. x=√10
C. x=−√10
D. x=10

Choices:
A. x=3
B. x=√10
C. x=−√10
D. x=10

No calculator is permitted.

If f(x)=4^(x−2)+1, which formula gives f⁻¹(x)?

A. log₄(x+1)−2
B. 4^(x+2)−1
C. log₄(x−1)+2
D. log_(1/4)(x−1)+2

Choices:
A. log₄(x+1)−2
B. 4^(x+2)−1
C. log₄(x−1)+2
D. log_(1/4)(x−1)+2

No calculator is permitted.

If f(x)=2x−5 and g(x)=x²+1, what is (g∘f)(x)?

A. (x²+1)²−5
B. (2x−4)²+1
C. (2x−5)²−1
D. (2x−5)²+1

Choices:
A. (x²+1)²−5
B. (2x−4)²+1
C. (2x−5)²−1
D. (2x−5)²+1

Calculator use is permitted.

For x=0,1,2,3,4, a quantity has values 6.1, 9.0, 13.6, 20.2, 30.5. Which claim is best supported?

A. An exponential model, because successive ratios are near 1.5
B. A linear model, because first differences are nearly constant
C. A quadratic model, because second differences are exactly constant
D. No model, because the values are not integers

Choices:
A. An exponential model, because successive ratios are near 1.5
B. A linear model, because first differences are nearly constant
C. A quadratic model, because second differences are exactly constant
D. No model, because the values are not integers

No calculator is permitted.

Points from y=ab^x lie on a line when log₁₀(y) is plotted against x. If the line has slope 0.3010, what is b approximately?

A. 0.301
B. 2
C. 1.301
D. 10.301

Choices:
A. 0.301
B. 2
C. 1.301
D. 10.301

Calculator use is permitted.

A logarithmic regression is y=4.8+2.3ln(x). What x gives y=12, to the nearest tenth?

A. 8.4
B. 15.2
C. 31.7
D. 22.9

Choices:
A. 8.4
B. 15.2
C. 31.7
D. 22.9

No calculator is permitted.

What is the exact value of cos(5π/6)?

A. −√3/2
B. −1/2
C. 1/2
D. √3/2

Choices:
A. −√3/2
B. −1/2
C. 1/2
D. √3/2

No calculator is permitted.

Which function has midline y=−1, amplitude 3, period π, and a maximum at x=0?

A. 3sin(2x)−1
B. −3cos(x)−1
C. 3cos(2x)−1
D. 3cos(x/2)−1

Choices:
A. 3sin(2x)−1
B. −3cos(x)−1
C. 3cos(2x)−1
D. 3cos(x/2)−1

Calculator use is permitted.

A sinusoidal model is T(t)=18+7sin((π/6)(t−2)), where t is hours. What is T(5.5), to the nearest tenth?

A. 24.8
B. 11.2
C. 18.2
D. 25.0

Choices:
A. 24.8
B. 11.2
C. 18.2
D. 25.0

No calculator is permitted.

Which expression is equivalent to (1−cos²x)/sin x where sin x≠0?

A. cos x
B. tan x
C. sin x
D. 1

Choices:
A. cos x
B. tan x
C. sin x
D. 1

Calculator use is permitted.

For r=2+2cosθ, which statement best describes the graph?

A. A cardioid symmetric about the polar axis with a cusp at the pole
B. A circle centered at (2,0) with radius 2 and tangent to the pole
C. A four-petal rose symmetric about both coordinate axes with petal length 2
D. A cardioid symmetric about θ=π/2 with a cusp above the pole

Choices:
A. A cardioid symmetric about the polar axis with a cusp at the pole
B. A circle centered at (2,0) with radius 2 and tangent to the pole
C. A four-petal rose symmetric about both coordinate axes with petal length 2
D. A cardioid symmetric about θ=π/2 with a cusp above the pole

As x approaches negative infinity, what is the end behavior of f(x) = -3x^5 + 2x^2 - 1?

Choices:
A. f(x) approaches positive infinity
B. f(x) approaches negative infinity
C. f(x) approaches 0
D. f(x) oscillates without bound

For g(x) = (x^2-16)/[(x-4)(x+1)], which correctly describes the behavior of g at x=4 and at x=-1?

Choices:
A. A hole at x=4, and a vertical asymptote at x=-1
B. A vertical asymptote at x=4, and a hole at x=-1
C. Vertical asymptotes at both x=4 and x=-1
D. Holes at both x=4 and x=-1

A data set shows output values with a constant ratio of 1.2 between consecutive equal-interval inputs. A student instead runs an exponential regression on a calculator and obtains an r-squared value of 0.999, citing this as justification that the data is exponential. Is this reasoning valid for determining the appropriate model type?

Choices:
A. No -- the constant ratio itself is what establishes an exponential model; a high r-squared value alone is not sufficient justification
B. Yes -- a high r-squared value is sufficient to justify any regression model type
C. No -- only a perfect r-squared of 1 would justify the model
D. Yes, but only if r-squared is reported to at least four decimal places

Which expression is equivalent to log base 5 of (25x^3)?

Choices:
A. 2 + 3*log base 5 of x
B. 6*log base 5 of x
C. log base 5 of 25, plus 3*log base 5 of x
D. 5 + 3*log base 5 of x

What is the solution set of e^(2x) - 4e^x + 3 = 0?

Choices:
A. x=0 and x=ln(3)
B. x=1 and x=3
C. x=ln(3) only
D. No real solution

A sinusoidal function completes 4 full cycles every 24 seconds. What is the value of b in the general form y = a*sin(b(x+c)) + d?

Choices:
A. pi/3
B. pi/12
C. 4
D. 24

What is the exact value of cos(5*pi/6)?

Choices:
A. -(the square root of 3)/2
B. (the square root of 3)/2
C. -1/2
D. 1/2

Convert the polar coordinates (r,theta) = (-4, pi/3) to rectangular coordinates.

Choices:
A. (-2, -2*(the square root of 3))
B. (2, 2*(the square root of 3))
C. (-2, 2*(the square root of 3))
D. (-2*(the square root of 3), -2)

A function's outputs at equally spaced inputs have constant third differences, but non-constant second differences. What is the minimum degree of a polynomial that could model this data?

Choices:
A. 3
B. 2
C. 4
D. 6

For which value of x is csc(x) undefined?

Choices:
A. x = pi
B. x = pi/2
C. x = pi/4
D. x = 3*pi/2
